title: ECHO mini-drop — utility people can use
summary: Three small ECHO updates add a canonical utility hub, two live product quote inspectors, and wallet-ready token actions.

builds.name: Canonical ECHO utility hub
builds.shortUpdate: A clean ECHO page now groups four current utility paths, contract proof, wallet actions, and machine-readable data.
builds.socialPost:
https://www.builtbyecho.xyz/echo

ECHO has a new home. One page now shows 4 current utility paths, 2 live product quote lanes, wallet actions, Base contract proof, and agent-readable JSON.

Use ECHO, don't just explain it.

builds.name: Two live ECHO quote inspectors
builds.shortUpdate: The new hub loads current ECHO amounts from the public Gauntlet and Public API Finder quote endpoints before a wallet action.
builds.socialPost:
https://www.builtbyecho.xyz/echo#use-echo

Two BuiltByEcho tools now expose live ECHO quotes on Base: Gauntlet for website teardowns and Public API Finder for ranked API searches. Inspect the amount first. Approve only when you're ready.

builds.name: Wallet actions and public utility data
builds.shortUpdate: Visitors can copy the canonical contract, request Add Token from a wallet extension, and read current verified utility paths from public JSON.
builds.socialPost:
https://www.builtbyecho.xyz/data/echo-utility.json

ECHO utility is now machine-readable. Agents and community tools can read the Base contract, chain ID, current paths, status, summaries, and proof URLs from one public JSON feed.

No vague roadmap required.

disclaimer: These posts describe current product utility. They do not promise token price or returns and are not financial advice.
